arxiv-1401-0500.title: Kinser inequalities and related matroids
arxiv-1401-0500.creator: Amanda Cameron
arxiv-1401-0500.description: Abstract Kinser developed a hierarchy of inequalities dealing with the dimensions of certain spaces constructed from a given quantity of subspaces. These inequalities can be applied to the rank function of a matroid, a geometric object concerned with dependencies of subsets of a ground set.

arxiv-2101-05875.title: Interpretable Multi-Head Self-Attention model for Sarcasm Detection in social media
arxiv-2101-05875.creator: Ramya Akula, Ivan Garibay
arxiv-2101-05875.description: Abstract Sarcasm is a linguistic expression often used to communicate the opposite of what is said, usually something that is very unpleasant with an intention to insult or ridicule. Inherent ambiguity in sarcastic expressions, make sarcasm detection very difficult. In this work, we focus on detecting sarcasm in textual conversations from various social networking platforms and online media.

arxiv-2404-01026.title: Modelling Multiplicative Linear Logic via Deep Inference
arxiv-2404-01026.creator: Tomer Galor, Andrea Schalk
arxiv-2404-01026.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tomer Galor, Andrea Schalk. Multiplicative linear logic is a very well studied formal system, and most such studies are concerned with the one-sided sequent calculus. In this paper we look in detail at existing translations between a deep inference system and the standard sequent calculus one, provide a simplified translation, and provide a formal proof that a standard approach to modelling is indeed invariant to all these translations.

arxiv-2509-18381.title: Multi-Target Detection for Cognitive MIMO Radar Networks
arxiv-2509-18381.creator: Nicholas L.K. Goradia, Harpreet S. Dhillon, and R. Michael Buehrer
arxiv-2509-18381.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nicholas L.K. Goradia, Harpreet S. Dhillon, and R. Michael Buehrer. In this work, we develop centralized and decentralized signal fusion techniques for constant false alarm rate (CFAR) multi-target detection with a cognitive radar network in unknown noise and clutter distributions. Further, we first develop a detection statistic for co-located monostatic MIMO radar in unknown noise and clutter distributions which is asymptotically CFAR as the number of received pulses over all antennas grows large, and we provide conditions under which this detection statistic is valid.

arxiv-2602-12581.title: The condition number of a random banded Toeplitz matrix is typically large
arxiv-2602-12581.creator: Paulo Manrique
arxiv-2602-12581.description: Abstract . It is well known that square matrices with independent and identically distributed (iid) random entries are typically well conditioned. A natural question is whether this favorable behavior persists for random matrices whose entries obey additional structure, i.e., their position inside of the matrix.

pmc-12609277.title: Advances in Laser Therapy for Hidradenitis Suppurativa: A Systematic Assessment of Current Evidence
pmc-12609277.creator: Michał Gawroński, Kinga Bukowczyk, Julia Chęcińska, Julita Krupiczowicz, Michalina Kołomyjec, Magdalena Łyko, Alina Jankowska-Konsur
pmc-12609277.description: Background: Hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) is a chronic, recurrent skin disease that significantly impairs patients’ quality of life both physically and mentally. It often requires a complex treatment process. Laser therapy, which is highly effective and well-tolerated, is an effective alternative to pharmacological treatment. This review aimed to synthesize information on laser therapy for HS, highlighting its clinical outcomes.

pmc-12628841.title: Icariin Inhibits Lung Adenocarcinoma Progression Through TP53-Mediated Ferroptosis
pmc-12628841.creator: Qihua Jin, Li OuYang, Jingjing Li, Xiaoxia Yang, Lihua Guo
pmc-12628841.description: PurposeLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) represents the predominant histological subtype of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and is linked to a diminished overall survival (OS) rate. Icariin (ICA), the principal bioactive compound found in the medicinal plant Epimedium, has demonstrated significant efficacy in inhibiting tumor progression. Ferroptosis, an emerging mechanism of cellular demise, offers a promising avenue for therapeutic intervention in oncology.

pmc-13537522.title: Multisystem FDG-avid sarcoidosis with osseous involvement mimicking disseminated metastatic malignancy
pmc-13537522.creator: Jamil Wafi, Mohammed Alkhanafsa, Soud Deek, Aya Alqattaa, Mohammed Alkhatib, Bara Wazwaz, Irfan Ul Haq
pmc-13537522.description: Sarcoidosis may closely mimic disseminated malignancy on FDG-PET/CT because active granulomatous inflammation can demonstrate intense multisystem FDG uptake. We report a 59-year-old woman with previously diagnosed pulmonary sarcoidosis who presented with acute dyspnea and right leg pain and was found to have segmental and subsegmental pulmonary emboli on CT pulmonary angiography.

pmc-13581453.title: Natural medicines for asthma management: mechanisms aligned with endotypes and multi-dimensional intervention
pmc-13581453.creator: Jiaxiang Sun, Hui Wang, Xue Li, Ping Wang, Ruibing Li, Sihui Xing, Dandan Wang, Liping Sun
pmc-13581453.description: BackgroundAsthma is a heterogeneous chronic inflammatory airway disease affecting over 300 million people globally. Inhaled corticosteroids remain first-line therapy but cause adverse effects and fail to address core pathologies in 5%–10% of patients—particularly those with Type 2-low endotypes exhibiting glucocorticoid resistance. Natural medicines, with multi-component synergy, offer a promising strategy to bridge this gap.
